completion_rule: Complete requirements 1-3 and plus at least one other.

requirements.text: Play at least two different games by yourself; one may be a video game.
Play a board game or another inside game with one or more members of your den.
Play a problem-solving game with your den.
With your parent's or guardian's permission, do the following:

children.text: Play a video game with family members or den members in a tournament.
List at least three tips that would help someone who was learning how to play your favorite video game.
Play an appropriate video game with a friend for 30 minutes.

requirements.text: With other members of your den, invent a game, OR change the rules of a game you know, and play the game.
Play a team game with your den
